summary: Welcome, to the Crystal Rose Festival, we've got even more fancy suits! Structured changes across 25 entities this patch.

champions.name: Ahri
champions.tldr: Base health reduced to 500 from 526.; Health growth reduced to 82 from 92.
champions.gameplayImpact: Ahri was adjusted in mixed directions. Net power depends on playstyle — read the numbers before assuming a free buff or hard nerf.

lines.label: Base health
lines.note: Base health reduced to 500 from 526.

lines.label: Health growth
lines.note: Health growth reduced to 82 from 92.

lines.label: Base health regeneration
lines.note: Base health regeneration reduced to 2.5 from 5.5.

lines.label: Base armor
lines.note: Base armor reduced to 18 from 21.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Innate Effect: Ahri gains 1 Essence Fragment whenever she kills a minion or monster. After obtaining 9 fragments, she consumes them to heal herself for 40–120 (+ 25% AP).

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Old Innate Effect: Ahri's abilities grant a stack of Essence Theft for each enemy hit, up to 3 stacks per ability cast. Upon reaching 9 stacks, Ahri's next ability heals her for 3–18 (lv 1–16) (+ 9% AP) for each enemy hit and consumes the stacks if at least one enemy is hit.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Innate Effect: When Ahri scores a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them, she consumes their essence to heal herself for 80–200 (+ 35% AP).

lines.label: Change
lines.note: VFX and SFX have been updated for all skins.

lines.label: Mana cost
lines.note: Mana cost changed to 60–100 from 65–85.

lines.label: AP ratio
lines.note: AP ratio increased to 40% AP from 35% AP.

lines.label: Base damage
lines.note: Base damage increased to 60–160 from 40–140.

lines.label: Mana cost
lines.note: Mana cost reduced to 25 from 45.

lines.label: Flame duration
lines.note: Flame duration reduced to 2.5 seconds from 5.

lines.label: Bonus movement speed duration
lines.note: Bonus movement speed duration increased to 2 seconds from 1.5.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Improved missile targeting and last hitting logic.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cleaned up VFX and enhanced missile movement.

lines.label: Base damage
lines.note: Base damage increased to 80–200 from 60–180.

lines.label: AP ratio
lines.note: AP ratio increased to 60% AP from 40% AP.

lines.label: Mana cost
lines.note: Mana cost reduced to 50 from 70.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Removed: Hitting an enemy with Charm no longer renders them vulnerable for 3 seconds, making them take 20% bonus damage from her abilities, including the Charm that triggered it.

lines.label: Recast duration
lines.note: Recast duration increased to 15 seconds from 10.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Cooldown now begins after the first cast, rather than after the effect ends.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Consuming a champion's essence with Essence Theft}} while active extends the ability's recast duration by and up to 10 seconds and grants an additional recast, storing up to 3 recasts.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Recast duration now persists after using all recasts.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cleaned up VFX and new ammo bar icons have been added to indicate the number of stored casts.
